business.about: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing, developing and marketing a wide range of branded and generic formulations and Active Pharma Ingredients (APIs). The company and its subsidiaries has various manufacturing facilities spread across the world with trading and other incidental and related activities extending to global market. [1] It is the largest pharmaceutical company in India. [2]

results.read: Revenue +12% YoY; EBITDA margin compressed 198 bps YoY to 29%; PAT -36% — sales growth didn't reach the bottom line.

calls: Margins expanding: 28% latest vs 25% average of prior years
Strong cash conversion: 5-yr operating cash flow is 1.20× reported profit
